answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 20918 Country: India Title: My question is do islam permit to celebarate the birthday.or what do shariyat says about celebrating birthday. Question: Assalamualiakum, My question is do islam permit to celebarate the birthday.or what do shariyat says about celebrating birthday. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 20918 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 516/439/B=1431) This practice is not proved by the holy Quran , Hadith , the companions of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ), tabein, (successors to the companions of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) and the four Imams . The tradition of birthday celebration has been invented by the Jews and Christians. This is a nonsense practice according to Islam. من حسن إسلام المرء تركه مالا يعنيه (ترمذي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
